title: Serum iron

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: A serum iron test measures the amount of iron in the blood. Iron is a mineral the body uses to make hemoglobin, which carries oxygen in red blood cells.
context: The amount of iron in the blood varies during the day and may be higher in the morning. A result outside the usual range does not always mean a condition that needs care, and some medicines, such as birth control pills and estrogen, along with menstrual cycles, can affect iron levels.
aboveRange: Higher levels may be associated with iron overload (hemochromatosis)
May be associated with lead poisoning
May be associated with some liver conditions
belowRange: Lower levels can be associated with iron deficiency anemia
May be associated with another type of anemia
May be associated with thalassemia, an inherited blood disorder
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
